column11: the progressive share, which is exactly what TETON-PPF requires: inclusion 4 admits only 'a diagnosis of PPF (other than IPF) that fulfills at least 1 of the following criteria for progression within 24 months of screening despite standard treatment of ILD'. The published incidence of progressive pulmonary fibrosis in CTD-ILD is 29% (95% CI 25 to 34): Yi M, Li M, Zhang Z, Li H, Sai J, Gui Y, Wang Z, 'Incidence and influencing factors of progressive pulmonary fibrosis in connective tissue disease-associated interstitial lung disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis', Front Immunol 2026;17:1758437 (doi 10.3389/fimmu.2026.1758437, PMID 41716405, PMC12913582), 22 studies, 20 of them high quality on the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale. 194,341 x 0.29 = 56,359 patients. The same share the book's Benlysta layer on this descriptor carries
column12: one sourced share and no stack. Two of the trial's filters are not cut, for want of a published share: fibrosis of more than 10% extent on HRCT, and FVC of 45% predicted or better. Both would narrow it, so the share reads high. Against that, the meta-analysis is mostly non-US cohorts and its by-disease rates range from 18% in SLE to 32% in Sjogren's

column11: a judgement at one in ten, the same share the book's Benlysta layer carries on this identical pool so the two claimants on it compare like with like, and checked against something measured. The check: inhaled treprostinil already reaches 5,611 Medicare beneficiaries a year in its approved diseases, 4,385 on Tyvaso DPI in Part D and 1,226 on nebulized Tyvaso in Part B in 2024 (CMS Medicare Part D and Part B spending by drug, the book's drug_demand rows for assets 79 and 98). One in ten of the 56,359 eligible here is 5,636 patients, which is that same reach again. The competitive case: nintedanib is the approved incumbent for chronic fibrosing ILD with a progressive phenotype and TETON-PPF allows it to continue, so inhaled treprostinil would arrive as an add-on rather than a replacement, which widens use and caps share; against it, four times daily nebulisation is a heavy regimen for patients who are already on an oral antifibrotic
column12: the direction it errs in: high. A peak share is settled by years of sales, not by an event, so no replacement clause is offered
